cmd: tc filter add dev v0p1 parent ffff: handle 1 protocol ip prio 1 basic match 'cmp(u32 at 4 layer link mask 0xff00ff00 eq 3)' action skbedit mark 7 pipe action gact drop
desc: positive: Add basic filter with cmp ematch u32/link layer and multiple actions

match.pattern: (?sm)^filter parent ffff: protocol ip pref 1 basic.*handle 0x1.*cmp\(u32 at 4 layer 0 mask 0xff00ff00 eq 3\).*action.*skbedit.*mark 7 pipe.*action.*gact action drop
